notes.title: Settings Menu Update
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

It's been a while since the last update, but this one adds a new settings menu. An issue we've had for a while is our music being very loud by default. You can now customize the volume of both the sound effects and music. Along with this you can change the resolution of your game.

Currently the full screen option isn't functional, this is a bug we've been working on for a while, but we decided to push this update anyway so that we can get the sound and resolution options into the game. This bug will be fixed as soon as we can.

As always feel free to let us know of any feedback you have, you can do so in the Fogbound discord: https://discord.gg/vDkCqQX 

Have Fun!
-Fogbound Dev Team

notes.title: Feature Update, and Contest!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Just wanted to let everyone know that yesterday we pushed an update that integrated Steam leader-boards with the score you get in the game. You'll see a menu you can navigate to in the main menu.

Whoever has the high score by June 1st will receive a free copy of the game to give to one of their friends!

Have fun!
-Fogbound Dev Team

notes.title: 4-4-2018 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Major Changes:
   - Changed models for cars
   - Changed some sounds
   - Text now changes when using a controller

Minor Changes:
   - Re-adjusted VCR effects
   - Changed a few text elements
 
Bug Fixes:
   - Fixed lines on road so that they stay the same distance apart
   - Fixed a bug where when you go back to main menu your mouse wouldn't 
appear
   - Fixed a bug where you couldn't return to the main menu during death screen
   - Fixed a bug where on ultra-wide and 4k displays the main menu buttons 
would overlap

notes.title: 4-2-2018 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Major Changes-
   - Now supports mouse menu navigation
   - Added visible lanes
   - Changed wave speed and patterns
   - Slightly increased player speed

Minor Changes-
   - Decreased amount of VHS lines
   - Added vignette to corners of screen
   - Made cars fall slowly towards the city when hit

Bug Fixes-
   - Fixed a bug where players would die when clipping oncoming cars from the front
   - Fixed a bug where occasionally oncoming traffic would create an impossible senario

notes.title: First Announcement!
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

Thanks for looking at Cyber Escape. My name is Ethan and I'm the lead developer on the game. I wanted to let everyone know that I plan to continue to support the development of Cyber Escape and release frequent content updates, so please stay active and watch for updates. If you want to join the Fogbound discord server, we'll be posting sneak peaks and other announcements there: https://discord.gg/vDkCqQX
